gaps: Datasheet gives no pin numbers or pin names; only the polarity rule 'color band denotes cathode end' (p1). K/A names and 1=K numbering are a convention, not datasheet values.
The ratings table (p1) is garbled in the text layer; values were read from the rendered page. The SK104C and SK1045C share one column.
RthJA 25 C/W (p1) is given without the mounting or copper area condition.
IF(AV) 10 A condition (case or lead temperature) is only shown in the Fig.1 derating curve vs case temperature (p2); no tabulated temperature.
VF is tabulated only at 10 A (0.55 V max); VF at the pump current (7.5 A run, 15-20 A stall/inrush) and its temperature dependence are only in the typical curve Fig.3 (p2).
No junction capacitance or reverse recovery value tabulated; Fig.4 typical capacitance curve only (p2).
Datasheet quirk: page 1 header reads 'SK104C THRU SK1020C' while pages 2-3 read 'SK104C THRU SK2010C'.
